description:
Trial Presentation Software

OnCue is the most reliable trial presentation software designed from the ground up by full-time trial presentation consultants.  Since 2014, OnCue has been used in thousands of trials of all sizes. OnCue is laser focused on creating the best presentation software available for the legal industry—simple workflows, powerful tools, blazing fast presentation.
65 fixes and 19 new features since 4.5.1410

**Hotfix**: Fixed editing designation page/line in Designation Editor

###What's New:

**Media Bar**
* Fixed: Error adding notebook: Assertion failure: i is between 0 and 1
* Fixed: With many lists selected, media summary can be slow to calculate and cancel
* Fixed: Add to Notebook is not available on right-click when both docs and pages are selected
* Fixed: Delete from database (not disk) may leave document open in memory cache
* Fixed: Copy/pasting a doc from a notebook onto another doc in a notebook throws an error
* Fixed: Notebook sort by date should sort use media date if possible
* Fixed: Mark as admitted filter has no effect when searching media bar
* Fixed: Clip name may revert to default when parent ID is changed
* Fixed: Bulk rename popup throws error when using Replace Text with names containing parentheses

**Documents**
* Fixed: Sticker text may be misaligned when page is taller than 11 inches
* Fixed: Adding sticker may alter PDF page's paper size
* Fixed: Callout may reappear after deleting when Add to Target Notebook is turned on
* Fixed: Printed page size does not reflect page size chosen in print dialog
* Fixed: Allow editing/removing stickers on stamped image files

**Audiovisuals**
* New: Add streaming, caching to waveform provider
* Fixed: Video may fail to load if format can't be auto-detected
* Fixed: Waveform may show waveform from prior video if file has no audio
* Fixed: Optimize Video may not use chosen resolution, and use 1080p instead
* Fixed: Optimize Video should work even if it can't probe the original encoding format

**Presentation and Viewer**
* Fixed: Viewer may not update when quickly changing media bar selection
* Fixed: Viewer may fail to update media ID on footer when media changes
* Fixed: Dialog boxes should not prevent Presentation from being focused

**Designations**
* New: Allow publishing a designation/list without linked media
* New: Add Arial Narrow as option for scrolling designation text
* Fixed: Remove overlaps may not order removed overlaps correctly
* Fixed: Designation Wizard may cause pause indicators to reappear on tuned designations
* Fixed: After remapping video, filename may revert after saving in Designation Editor or Sync tool
* Fixed: After remapping a deposition video, viewer playback buttons may not become active
* Fixed: Transcript viewer may not see video after remapping
* Fixed: When scrolling a long designation in transcript to drop link, the scroll resets after link is added
* Fixed: Improve error in Wizard when designation begins on line beyond end of page range
* Fixed: When 'Begin playback when presenting' is OFF, publishing linked media may pause designation
* Fixed: Transcript text find/replace throws error when using Replace All: startIndex cannot be larger than...
* Fixed: Actions menu should not show when editing designation text
* Fixed: Error when showing designation in transcript viewer: Object reference not set...

**ProSync**
* New: ProSync - Add queue for batch processing
* New: ProSync - Add option to pause and resume syncing
* New: Make transcript drop-down filter match on any part of the ID
* New: ProSync - Add option to enter a custom code or identifier when activating
* New: Allow managing ProSync credits without needing a transcript or case
* Fixed: Allow ProSync to use more than 12 CPU cores
* Fixed: Reduce ProSync worker CPU contention to increase throughput
* Fixed: ProSync may hang due to crashed worker: FATAL: UNHANDLED_EXCEPTION (code=0xE06D7363)
* Fixed: ProSync checkout may stop working if user account password is reset by admin
* Fixed: Move ProSync logs to log folder for Error Reporting
* Fixed: ProSync - Enable Sync button on collapsed toolbar doesn't do anything when clicked

**Import and Export**
* New: New text/docx transcript import engine
* New: Include name/bates in script/list export
* New: Include Name/Bates for media in Notebook Package export
* New: Include documents in notebook package
* New: Include audiovisual files in notebook package
* New: Include native file pointers in exported notebooks
* New: Include media script, designation list xml within Notebook package
* Fixed: Exhibit list export from Notebook should include descendant media
* Fixed: Transcript text import may fail to detect that page numbers fall at the end of the page
* Fixed: Imported ascii transcript with page numbers may bring in an extra line on page 25
* Fixed: Word doc transcript import does not recognise line breaks
* Fixed: Import fails when text transcript is missing page numbers near the end
* Fixed: Attached transcripts import with incorrect page numbers
* Fixed: Exported designation video may not set full page/line range in filename when grouped
* Fixed: Error exporting notebook with designated transcript: Saved annotation file not found.
* Fixed: Typo when browsing for notebooks to import: 'All motebook files'
* Fixed: MDB Export - Transcript is missing page row
* Fixed: Add explanation to Export Media Files that it exports the original full file
* Fixed: Error exporting video when scrolling text overflows bounds: Padded dimensions cannot be...

**Other**
* New: Add feedback and error reporting
* New: Add command-line arg to enable full keyboard navigation on launch
* New: Add default 'Click here to open a workspace' message when all panes are closed
* New: Add 'Save conflict/error details' to Add Media popup, which shows path of media conflict
* Fixed: Tune database search indices for faster search
* Fixed: Increase database block size for faster I/O when case is on a NAS
* Fixed: Long names may get cut off in display selector
* Fixed: Remove default options from settings file
* Fixed: Migrate database engine to Microsoft.Data.Sqlite
* Fixed: Update Source Sans Pro to Source Sans 3
* Fixed: Harden updater against corrupt/invalid binaries
* Fixed: Improve database change tracker performance
* Fixed: Setup may lose custom install path when upgrading
* Fixed: Error on app shutdown - COM object that has been separated from its underlying RCW...
* Fixed: Error on app shutdown: System.ComponentModel.Win32Exception: Invalid window handle
* Fixed: Files pane - Folder subtree should auto-refresh when parent is clicked
* Fixed: Fix accessibility compliance issues
* Fixed: Update third party software disclosures
* Fixed: Bump System.Security.Cryptography.* to 10.0.13
